reason: After the wandering scare and the police call I cannot keep doing this on luck. If I can see where Dad is and talk to him the moment something goes wrong, that is worth $249 even with another monthly bill, and the 30-day full refund means I am not gambling on it.
objection: Dad will take it off or refuse to wear it. He hates anything that looks like a medical device, and a camera on a man with dementia might just make him more agitated. I also do not want another subscription I forget to cancel.
would_change_my_mind: A clip-on that does not look like a medical device, plus a guarantee that it would have caught the wandering incident before he got far, would make me buy it right away.
